utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can use any spare screws, tape, or tools you don’t need — I’ll sort the rest out here. I’m free this afternoon after 3.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it. Please let me know as soon as you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send the time and place soon. That helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know it’s at the repair drive location this evening. Hope a few more neighbors can swing by!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That really helps — I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep at it and make sure more neighbors hear about the repair drive this evening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window still looks good on my end, and I’ll double-check the school schedule for any conflicts. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — that helps. Let’s keep the repair drive simple and stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — keeping it simple makes this much easier. I’ll confirm the school side and keep you posted if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I can help with sorting the donated parts. Just point me to where to start and I’ll get going.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — start with the boxes by the table and separate screws, tools, and anything electronic. I’ll be over in a bit to help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll start with the boxes by the table and sort out the screws, tools, and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that helps. Once you confirm the time and place, I can keep the list organized around the boxes, tape, and truck.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’ll verify the time and place first, then I’ll send you the confirmed details so you can keep the list organized.

utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m a little late again, but I can do a quick inventory run and see what supplies we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — check what we’re short on, and we’ll start with the homes that need help most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check the supplies and report back so you can start with those homes first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not caught up on the latest tally—did we get enough help for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the full tally yet, but I can help check on who’s still needed. If you hear anything, send it my way and I’ll coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I probably missed the latest update, but I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — late afternoon after pickup still feels best on my end. If you’ve got any updates on supplies or timing, just send them along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’m free after 3, and I’ll send a quick supply update once I’ve checked what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — after 3 works well, and I appreciate the supply update. Just send me what you find, and I’ll keep everything lined up for late afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still on — I’ll be there by 3, and we’ll start with the houses that need the most help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — just wanted to confirm you’ll be there by 3, right?
